reference_policy: Only the frozen RF/LightGBM F6 models are scored on TEST to calculate same-family test Delta_s; not extra candidates or model selection.
threshold_rule: Maximize hardware-alert recall subject to combined Y in {0,4} FPR <= .01; break equal-recall ties by lower FPR, then higher threshold.
threshold_sentinel: Finite nextafter(max score,+infinity) included; zero-alert point is feasible, but zero recall must be disclosed.
delta_policy: Primary final Delta_s uses frozen same-family F6 TEST scores; Stage 2 validation Delta_s also retained separately. LR F6 is a reference: sparse-channel/Delta conditions not applicable.
resources: Reuse corrected frozen Stage 2 block-13 100-warmup/2000 single-observation end-to-end measurements, including two-thread settings; do not combine with Stage 1 batch-average timings.
dropout: Preserve existing LR F6/RF E4 block-13 outcomes; evaluate LightGBM E4 with identical 328 even-position, seed42 row mask and seed44 E4 channel mask.

explanation_sample.strategy: Uniform without replacement within each class; class balanced, not representative of prevalence. Sorted source positions; 3 permutation repeats.

explainability: LR standardized coefficients, RF impurity importance, LightGBM gain and native exact Tree SHAP raw-score contributions. Raw-channel permutation regenerates dependent features. SHAP sample only; no causality.
prior_test_disclosure: The approved test partition was evaluated in an earlier legacy implementation and is not pristine or previously unseen. Revised settings were frozen from training/block13, and thresholds from block14. No legacy test metrics are read by revised selection code; earlier human exposure cannot be undone or independently disproved by software.
